text:
maya: Hey team — AcmeCorp just hit autopay for invoice INV-2389 and it failed. Customer reported a 3DS popup that never completed (looks like it was blocked). Invoice ID: INV-2389, Customer: acme-enterprise, last4: 4242, attempted on prod at 2025-11-05T14:02Z. Can payments ops take a look?

billing-bot: Payment attempt log: attempt_id=pay_9f8b, gateway=Stripe (eu-west1), acquirer_code=DO_NOT_HONOR, auth_method=3DS, acs_status=CHALLENGE_REQUIRED, browser_error="Refused to display 'https://acs.example-acs.com' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin'"

sam: Thanks — that X-Frame-Options error screams embedded ACS/iframe blocked by ACS policy or customer CSP. Any chance Acme has a strict CSP on their hosted payment page?

maya: Customer says they use our hosted invoice iframe embedded in their internal admin portal. They pasted screenshot showing browser console: `Refused to load frame because it violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "frame-src 'self' https://pay.redwood.ai"`

jordan: Repro steps I used: 1) Create a demo invoice in prod-mode for acme-enterprise 2) Open the invoice within their admin iframe 3) Click Pay -> our hosted iframe opens 4) ACS redirect tries to load remote ACS iframe and gets `X-Frame-Options: sameorigin` from ACS -> browser blocks -> challenge never delivered -> gateway returns DO_NOT_HONOR.

sam: That matches. Two actionable paths: (A) fallback to redirect flow where we open ACS page in top-level navigation (requires update to hosted flow + UX) or (B) ask customer to allow the ACS domain/frame in their CSP / remove embedding for invoice pages.

maya: Customer is enterprise and won't change CSP broadly. They asked for a quick fix so autopay can succeed today.

jordan: Short-term mitigation: disable embedded 3DS for that customer and force redirect flow for any CHALLENGE_REQUIRED responses. I can flip that flag for acme-enterprise in tenant config. Will that work, @sam?

sam: Yes — we have a per-tenant flag `payments.3ds.iframe_enabled` default true. Setting it false will cause a top-level redirect challenge on the next attempt. Note implications: UX will open a new tab for payer to complete challenge.

maya: Please flip it and retry a payment attempt. Also customer requested we do a single manual retry instead of waiting for next automatic autopay window.

jordan: Done — flipped `payments.3ds.iframe_enabled=false` for tenant acme-enterprise (change_id=cfg_342). I've queued a manual retry: attempt_id=pay_9f8b-retry -> monitoring now.

billing-bot: Manual retry event: attempt_id=pay_9f8b-retry, status=PENDING_REDIRECT, redirect_url=https://pay.redwood.ai/3ds/redirect?attempt=pay_9f8b-retry

maya: Shared redirect link with Acme billing contact. They completed the challenge; payment succeeded. Confirmed invoice INV-2389 is now paid. Customer asks for root cause & long term fix.

sam: Root cause summary to provide customer: Some ACS providers send `X-Frame-Options: sameorigin` which prevents embedded ACS flows. When our hosted invoice is embedded in a third-party page with a strict CSP or cross-origin context, browser blocks the ACS iframe. We already detect this via browser console errors; long-term fix options: 1) default to redirect-based 3DS for embedded contexts, 2) provide a hosted top-level checkout link to be opened outside the embed, or 3) work with acquirers/ACS to support `frame-ancestors` properly (less feasible).

finance-team: For our records — mark invoice INV-2389 as autobalance-exempt for one cycle and note manual retry outside scheduled autopay. Also flag for potential refunds if customer reports duplicate.

maya: Thanks all. Action items: jordan to document tenant flag and run a quick audit to find other tenants with invoice pages embedded in external iframes; sam to create a ticket to default to redirect for embedded contexts (P2); I will send Acme a postmortem and the workaround steps.

jordan: I'll run a tenant scan (script: `scripts/find-embedded-invoices.sh`) and attach results here by EOD. Quick snippet I used to check the console in Chrome: ```window.addEventListener('error', e => console.log(e.message));```

sam: Opening ticket INFR-1227 to track redirect-fallback for CHALLENGE_REQUIRED flows. Assigning to eng-payments.

maya: Closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
